live_derivation.orphan_count_note: Differs from both the filed 10-item list and the research report's 13-item snapshot by name set (churn confirmed): 6 orphans (agent-system, context-loading, essential-refactor, mcp-integration, orchestration-concurrency, wezterm-notifications) had prior completed-task users in specs/archive/state.json's completed_projects[] -- safe prune, used only by completed tasks. The other 7 (commit-scoping-concurrency, cslib, memory-improvement-loop, orchestrate-admission-gate, status-marker-lifecycle, team-mode-lifecycle, workflow-refactor) had zero users anywhere: not in active_projects, not in archive/state.json (archived_projects or completed_projects), and not in specs/vault/01-vault/state.json's active_projects -- never used by any task, safe prune.
